item.title: Very poor quality repair to dropped pavement, 8th November
item.description:
On 24th October 2026 at approximately 7am, contractors carried out a repair to the dropped kerb surface outside number 23/25. This area had been marked with white paint a few weeks earlier. The repair is of very poor quality and 2 weeks later it is coming apart and scattering tarmac stones across the road. A gentle brush of the area was able to remove large quantities of the stones as per the image.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 22, Eldon Road, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
